temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but dangerously overworked by hospital obligations, and that Gary needs rest and a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Gary's refusal confirms to Ethan that Gary is deeply consumed by work and unable or unwilling to step away, though Ethan does not yet know of any deeper cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is overcommitted at the hospital and resistant to taking care of himself; Ethan remains concerned and wants to help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried, concerned, and perhaps frustrated or helpless.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue trying to help Gary rest or accept support, possibly by persuading him toward the retreat or another intervention.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and his avoidance of discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked because of hospital demands and needs rest, though he may still be unsure why Gary is so resistant to opening up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan's belief shifts: Gary's overwork is likely not only professional. Gary appears to be hiding a deeper, complicated problem and may feel he has to protect Ethan from it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes there is more to Gary's situation than work obligations, and that Gary feels burdened and isolated.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, suspicious, empathetic, and worried about Gary's hidden struggles.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Gary that he is not a burden and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Ethan responds by suggesting they prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities, and Gary agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has a deeper, complicated personal or work-related problem but does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan's belief is clarified and confirmed: Gary's overwork is driven by new department pressures plus personal challenges, not simply poor time management.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's situation is understandable but improvable with practical support and better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief at understanding the truth, mixed with empathy for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary organize his schedule, delegate responsibilities, and create a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and remaining challenges, and says he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is struggling but open to help and capable of improving with support and practical changes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan's belief is strengthened: Gary is making genuine efforts and achieving measurable progress, though challenges may remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is on the right track toward a healthier work-life balance and is benefiting from continued support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in, offering encouragement, and supporting Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and says he feels more in control. Ethan tells Gary he is always available but believes Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and still benefits from support, but may be close to managing independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan's belief is confirmed: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of managing independently and that Ethan can step back while remaining available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back from active support but stay available if Gary ever needs him.
